newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech parl't approves first reading of 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Czech parl't approves first reading of 1997 budget.

text.p: The Czech lower house has rejected a plan by the opposition Social Democrats which would have forced a reworking of the government's 1997 draft budget, thus opening the way for a possible vote on the draft later on Wednesday.
Klaus earlier on Wednesday praised Wagner amid signs that an opposition split could hand the government victory.
Wagner had said that although he disagreed with the government on many things, the budget needed to be passed for the stability of the country.
Klaus said Wagner was putting the interests of the nation first by recommending that deputies approve the draft in its first reading.
Klaus's centre-right coalition has hinted it might resign if the opposition succeeded in forcing changes to the balanced budget.
